title: Rimac Nevera in the Night Studio on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Small work, done daily, gets loud over time.
description:
Step inside the quiet calm of the Night Studio, where a striking giallo yellow Rimac Nevera rests peacefully under the dim lights. Just past the glass, evening rain streaks downward, softening the distant city skyline into a dreamy, blurred glow. All you will hear is two hours of calm ambient electronic music, layered with warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle beat. Settle in and let this space keep you company while you work, study, or simply relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
